S this weekend, or possibly Monday where you try to break out of this. It could be some chop until the market finally decides what it wants to do. We have seen this many times before. And it's kind of obviously a gross oversimplification of of what The Clarity Act is doing. But yes, there are some flaws that obviously they're trying to work through. They're in Congress. This is why obviously the support from coinbase you know fell because again it seems like right now this bill would do a little more harm to the industry than helping it yes there are some things that would obviously help move us along but you know at the same time it could potentially cripple the industry here in the u.s and that's not what we want we've seen the kind of impact uh that's had from china um obviously with the big band back in 2021 did not it did not do great things for the market so you want to pass the right bill uh but that's that's all i got for you guys um we'll obviously see how the day progresses you know very well could be another day like yesterday where we think we're gonna drop and we get a spike it's not looking like that right now because we are start starting to get more into the full swing of the week, but we'll see what happens. I appreciate you guys. I hope you enjoyed the video. Let me know your thoughts below, but have a great day. Catch you guys in the next one. Take care.
